# Farouqk Designs

> Web design, local SEO, and lead generation for home service businesses —
> electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, renovation contractors, and interior
> designers. We build websites and SEO systems designed to convert local search
> traffic into booked jobs.

Farouqk Designs serves home service and trades businesses, primarily in
Nigeria. Core services: website design and development, local SEO, AI SEO /
answer engine optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, and
AI-powered lead generation.
